orders.title: A slow morning
orders.symptoms: Starter turns slowly; the battery test is weak.

orders.title: Charge warning
orders.symptoms: Battery warning stays on; inspect charging output and drive belt.

orders.title: Uneven idle
orders.symptoms: The coupe shakes at idle; both plug banks show ignition wear.

orders.title: Breathing room
orders.symptoms: Hatchback feels sluggish; intake restriction is high.

orders.title: Running hot
orders.symptoms: SUV temperature rises under load; radiator and upper hose need inspection.

orders.title: Brake vibration
orders.symptoms: Coupe braking is noisy with pedal vibration; check the front-left assembly.

orders.title: Grip restored
orders.symptoms: The hatchback slides early; all four tires have insufficient tread.

orders.title: Settle down
orders.symptoms: SUV bounces after corners; front-right damper is damaged.
